keep_playing_why: B gave me a decision every minute: three different toppings make a Club, towers counter enemy types, and each stage adds a new active, so I was playing differently by stage 3 and lost on stage 4 because of my own thin defence, which made me want to retry. A had one good idea (relaying a sunbeam off mirrors) but I spent nine minutes for two of three glyphs on level 1 and never saw the idea grow.
better_made_why: B ran smoothly from tap one, with clean menus, readable enemies, a boss with phases and lots of hit feedback; its audio is thinner than its visuals. A looks beautiful but took 17 s to load, gave no feedback for why a beam did not count, had no effect sounds, black frames after acts, and a camera that jammed against the character on the island.
